author: Flickr photographer Editor B / Bart Everson
caption: Banks Street Flooding. Flooded street in Mid-City New Orleans from long severe rain storms. "Here's what it looks like on the 4300 block of Banks right now. Normally you'd see a sidewalk there. (Hard to take a decent picture in the dark. I boosted the light levels here. Funny how the water looks like pavement.) At its deepest point the water is maybe knee-deep on a short person. "
note: Flooded street at night; parked cars sit on dry ground and nobody is in the water.

author: Contributor(s): I.P.C. Photo
caption: Children demonstrating the depth of flood waters in Mary Street, Brisbane, during the 1890 flood. A group of people including quite a few children have gathered near the intersection of Mary Street and Albert Street and are standing knee-deep in the floodwaters, 1890.
note: Crowd of children and adults; the caption says children are demonstrating the depth, and a child's knee is lower than an adult's.

author: Unknown author
caption: Floodwaters outside the Hotel Shakespeare, Barcaldine, Queensland, 1954. Pedestrians walk in knee-deep floods.
note: Pedestrians far off and small.

author: Au Morandarte from Chiswick/Romford, London, England
caption: Aguinaldo Highway at Bacoor. Flooding due to torrential rain, water levels reached knee-deep. This is taken at around 3am that morning. Flooding was also widespread across Manila.
note: Night; one vehicle's lights in the water, hard to see.

author: Au Morandarte from Chiswick/Romford, London, England
caption: Aguinaldo Highway, between Imus and Bacoor. Flooding due to torrential rain, water levels reached knee-deep. This is taken at around 3am that morning.
note: An SUV in the water at night.

author: B137
caption: en:Tidal flooding with rainwater than cannot drain in Miami and Miami Beach, Florida. During en:King tide season. See en:Miami Beach#Elevation and tidal flooding .
note: Close-up of one person's legs at night.

author: Collins, Tudor Washington, 1898-1970, photographer
caption: A man stands in knee-deep water holding two young boys. He looks down at a dog which is also in the water.
note: A man holding two boys in a flooded paddock; dogs in the water.

author: Collins, Tudor Washington, 1898-1970, photographer
caption: Two men wading through knee-deep water. The man on the left holds a boy under his arm. The man on the left is Tudor Collins and he is piggybacking another young boy.
note: Two men wading in a flooded paddock, each carrying a boy.

author: An United Press International photographer
caption: Stranded motorist gets some help in pushing his car through knee-deep water in Manila left by Typhoon Olga. Flash flooding caused by the typhoon has already left 22 dead in the Philippines. While Typhoon Olga was ripping across the Philippines, Typhoon Pamela was churning up 10-foot waves that swept ashore in Guam. Both storms dumped heavy rains in the South Pacific.
note: Manila, Typhoon Olga; a man pushes a car; high-contrast newspaper scan.

author: Community Archives
caption: The front of a postcard showing the floods in Belleville, Ontario, March 1936. To the left of the photo is a house, where people are standing knee deep in water next to a row boat. Written on back: Pushing boat into William Pearl Lane, Home 36 Colborne St.; Jack Johnson; Jack Smart in picture.
note: 1936 postcard, cracked print; people beside a row boat.

author: Unknown author
caption: House under flood at Tully, Queensland, ca. 1937. Two people stand in front of a highset Queenslander house during a flood at Tully. The water is knee-high.
note: The caption mentions two people, but none can be seen at this size.

author: Unknown author
caption: Ferrying locals across the floodwaters in Chinchilla during the 1921-22 floods. Several men in shirtsleeves evacuating Chinchilla townspeople by boat during the floods. The water is about knee-high, rising to the floor level of a number of wooden houses in the area.
note: Men beside a boat.

author: Hogg, John Jackson
caption: Floodwaters at Eagle Street wharves, Brisbane, 1890. Small boats are floating on floodwaters where the road should be. A horse pulling a cart is standing in water almost up to his belly and men are standing waist deep at the boat. Sailing ships are moored at the wharves, riding high on the water.
note: Men standing among boats; the caption's depth is a horse 'almost up to his belly'.

author: Senior Master Sgt. David H. Lipp, U.S. Air Force
caption: U.S. Air Force Master Sgt. Eric Johnson, 119th Wing, North Dakota Air National Guard, passes a sandbag along a human chain of flood fighters standing in knee-high floodwater southeast of Kindred, N.D., on April 21, 2009. Johnson is helping the group build a temporary flood levee to hold back rising water near a farmhouse. High water from the Sheyenne River is making its way over land and across roads posing a threat to residents of Cass County, N.D.
note: Two men passing a sandbag.

author: National Museum of the U.S. Navy
caption: 170901-M-BH832-018 WEST ORANGE, Texas (Sept. 1, 2017) U.S. Marine Corps 1st Sgt. John Herrera, a parachute rigger with Charlie Company, 4th Reconnaissance Battalion, 4th Marine Division, Marine Forces Reserve, wades through waist deep flood water in order to complete an emergency evacuation call in West Orange, Texas. Marine Corps Reserve forces are supporting FEMA and state and local officials, focused on life-saving efforts and resupply missions in the aftermath of Hurricane Harvey. (U.S. Mari
note: One Marine seen from behind.

author: Zachary West / National Guard
caption: Nationa Guardsman giving a woman a piggyback in waist deep floodwaters outside a house, Texas National Guard soldiers conduct rescue operations in flooded areas around Houston, Texas
note: A guardsman carrying a woman on his back.

The following front page news item, which includes information the effects of the flood on West Street shown in t

author: Unknown author
caption: Children playing in the flooded streets, Brisbane, 1893. Children are ankle deep in water in the middle of Mary Street, during the 1893 floods. Floodwaters are almost as high as the first floor of some buildings in the street.
note: Children only; Lusong leaves children out, so it may not measure.

note: One child only; Lusong leaves children out, so 'can't measure' is the right answer.

caption: Texas Guardsmen and Texas Task Force 1 rescue personnel wade through thigh-deep water to help stranded residents back to rescue vehicles during severe flooding in Wharton, Texas, April 21, 2016. In coordination with Texas Task Force 1 and the City of Wharton emergency services, a detachment from Delta Company of the 536th Brigade Support Battalion, Texas Army National Guard deployed several Light Multi-terrain Vehicles to floodwaters rescuing both people and pets. author: Unknown author
caption: View of the 1893 Brisbane flood from Albert Street to the Botanic Gardens.. View of the 1893 Brisbane floods from Albert Street to the Botanic Gardens. A boy is standing up to his knees in water in the left foreground, whilst a man sits in a boat a few metres behind him. Caption: 'Albert St to the Gardens'.
note: One boy only; Lusong leaves children out, so 'can't measure' is the right answer.

author: Unknown author
caption: Flood waters seen from the corner of Adelaide and Creek Streets, Brisbane, 1893. Street scene during 1893 flood in Brisbane. The view is looking down Creek Street toward the Brisbane River. The Gresham Hotel stands on the corner of Adelaide and Creek Streets with spectators standing on its lower balcony. A group of men, women, and children are gathered in a line at the water's edge while others row boats in the background. Some people are immersed in the water up to their waist or chest. Many in
note: Most people stand on dry ground in front; a few are in the water further down.

author: Unknown author
caption: Floodwaters surround the West End Brewery, West End, Brisbane, ca. 1890. Young children float by in tubs while men row their dinghies. A lone gas light stands in the middle of the water where the street should be and a young boy stands up to his waist in water.
note: The waist-deep one is a young boy; Lusong leaves children out.

author: Unknown author
caption: Rescuing stock during the 1928 flooding in Goovigen, Queensland. Riders moving through chest-high floodwaters during the 1928 flood. (Description supplied with photograph.).
note: Riders on horses and one swimmer; 'chest-high' is the horses'.

author: USMC Archives from Quantico, USA
caption: The caption on this photograph reads "Indifferent-Completely ignoring that fact that his camp is half submerged by heavy Okinawa rains, Marine Staff Sergeant A.S. Barnacle, of Minneapolis, Minn., stands knee deep in water to shave at his "Rube Goldberg" washstand." From the Photograph Collection (COLL/3948), Marine Corps Archives & Special Collections OFFICIAL USMC PHOTOGRAPH
note: Okinawa 1945: a Marine shaving knee deep in a flooded camp.

author: Mahinur11
caption: A misty river scene unfolds where tradition and community converge. Dozens of villagers stand waist-deep in the water, each holding a curved bamboo frame with nets stretched wide, their movements synchronized in a collective rhythm of survival and heritage. Brightly colored clothing contrasts with the muted tones of fog and water, while reflections ripple beneath them, doubling the sense of unity. The atmosphere feels timeless—an ancient practice carried forward, where resilience and togethernes
note: Wading, not a flooded street: dozens of villagers at a fishing festival (crowded).

In the foreground, there's a personal watercraft (jet ski) with what looks like an inflatable raft or flotation device attached to it in yellow and other colors. A person wearing a bright yellow life vest is standing in the water next to the watercraft. The water appears calm with gentle ripples, and in the background, you can see the distant shoreline with buildings and lights visibl
note: Wading, not a flooded street: an attendant in the sea beside a jet ski.

author: Shixart1985
caption: A person stands waist-deep in the ocean water, facing the horizon at sunset. Soft pastel colors fill the sky while gentle waves lap at the shore, creating a peaceful atmosphere.
note: Wading, not a flooded street: a man in the sea at sunset.

author: PattayaPatrol
caption: This photo features two women standing in the water at a beach, with one of them making a peace sign. They are both wearing white shirts, and one of them is also wearing black shorts. They are surrounded by a lively beach scene, with several other people in the background, some of whom are also in the water. There are numerous umbrellas scattered throughout the scene, providing shade for the beachgoers. A few chairs can be seen in the area, likely for people to relax and enjoy the beach atmosphe
note: Wading, not a flooded street: one woman standing in the water, another sitting on the edge.

caption: U.S. Army Spc. Claudy Antonie, left, a supply specialist, swims in chest-deep water using the travel stroke with the help of Sgt. (U.S. Army photo by Sgt. Ida Irby/Released)
note: Wading, not a flooded street: water-survival training in a pool.

caption: U.S. Marines with 7th Communication Battalion, III Marine Expeditionary Force Information Group, maneuver through chest deep water during Operation Odyssey Stormbreaker III at Jungle Warfare Training Center, Okinawa, Japan, Nov. 4, 2025. The exercise enhanced Marines’ ability to install, operate, and maintain tactical communications architecture while strengthening leadership, teamwork, and expeditionary readiness in support of III MEF operations across the Indo-Pacific. (U.S. Marine Corps photo
note: Wading, not a flooded street: Marines in a muddy training channel.
